author: PokerFace
body:
So, who wants to know the date of the Omega Update? I do and, so does everyone here! Whoever can correctly guess the date of the update shall be proclaimed as the Omega Update Guesser. I will start with my guess.

- Staff can't participate if they know.
- Also, no changing your answer after the OmegaUpdate is released. 
-No more than 1 answer.

If you are 1 day off, it may be because of the timezone differences so... you still might be right!

My guess is 4/1/2015
